nodes.rationale: Полноценная замена десктопа (D-02, D-03)

nodes.label: Attachment upload of a new note waits for its POST /v1/docs registration
nodes.rationale: Otherwise the server responds "note not found"; the registration itself restarts the pending upload.

nodes.label: Attachments in 1 MiB encrypted chunks (crypto.md §6), background upload after note registration
nodes.rationale: Encrypted chunks are stored in IndexedDB first so attaching works offline; upload of a new note's attachment waits for its POST /v1/docs registration, otherwise the server answers "note not found"; registration itself restarts the upload.

nodes.label: New document registered via REST queue (POST /v1/docs) before SyncClient subscribe; resubscribe if late
nodes.rationale: A document unknown to the server cannot be synced; late registration triggers SyncClient.resubscribe.

nodes.label: DocStore.open waits up to 15 s for the note row (deep link on a new device)
nodes.rationale: The notebook index can show a note opened by link on a new device before its row is saved in the docs table; without waiting, the note would open as an unsynced document.

nodes.label: Stored-docs mode (DocStore.acquire/release)
nodes.rationale: With 10 000 notes only 2 Y.Docs in memory instead of 10 003 (heap 72 MB vs 139 MB).

nodes.label: Stored-docs mode: Y.Doc only for open notes (DocStore.acquire/release)
nodes.rationale: При 10 000 заметок в памяти 2 Y.Doc вместо 10 003; куча 72 МБ вместо 139 МБ

nodes.label: Мок: POST /v1/__test/refuse-pushes (отказ в приёме push для e2e)
Отказ сервера в приёме правки → «Не отправлено: N» и «Повторить»
nodes.rationale: Если сервер отказал (forbidden, doc_not_found у зарегистрированного документа, bad_request, internal), правка не должна молча висеть «отправляется»: индикатор, как iOS SyncStatusBadge, показывает число документов с отказом и кнопку повтора; отметка снимается сама, когда у документа пусто в исходящей очереди.

Multi-tab session with Web Locks token refresh

nodes.label: Cross-tab token refresh under Web Locks
Web icons: SF Symbol names (iOS SymbolPicker palette) shown as similar emoji; unknown names hidden, never shown as text
nodes.rationale: Icons of spaces/notebooks/folders/notes are emoji (web) or SF Symbol names (iOS SymbolPicker); the web cannot draw SF Symbols, so it maps every palette symbol to a look-alike emoji and never renders the raw name like "house".
